Move-outs

Notice → inspection time → keys back → inspection next to the move-in checklist → deposit statement within 21 days (Wis. Stat. § 704.28) → refund. Former tenants keep read-only access 28 days after a voluntary move-out, 60 days after the sheriff's removal; then their sign-in is removed automatically.

Record a move-out by hand (paper notice, eviction, abandonment)
